name: Pendula
summary: A frosted glass hero for a lighting shop: brush seven glass pendant lamps to switch them on
about: A landing page for a glass lighting studio. Seven hand-blown pendant lamps hang from a glass rail inside a frosted panel; brush across them and they swing like real pendulums, flicker to life and pour light onto the glass. Below sit a shoppable collection with tints and a bag, the glass-making story and a showroom booking form.
how: The panel rises out of a blur, the rail draws itself and the seven lamps drop in on their cords and swing
Brush your pointer or finger across the lamps: each one swings with your speed and flickers on with sparks and a cone of light
Tap a lamp or press Enter on it to switch it off; arrow keys move between lamps
Use All on for a cascading wave, All off to send it back, and the Warmth and Dimmer sliders to change the glow
Pick a glass tint in the collection and add lamps to the bag; the bag drawer updates totals and reserves them
Scroll to follow the furnace track through four making steps, then book a showroom visit with a validated form
